    leadCaptureId           INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,

    fullName                NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,

    companyName             NVARCHAR(200) NULL,

    message                 NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,

    assignedTo              INT NULL,
    privacyConsentAccepted  BIT NOT NULL,
    created_At              DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    updated_at              DATETIME NULL,
    CONSTRAINT PK_leadCaptures PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (leadCaptureId ASC),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_LeadCaptures_NormalizedEmail UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED (normalizedEmail), -- Per ADR-002: Enforce rejection via persistent UNIQUE constraint.
    CONSTRAINT FK_leadCaptures_employees FOREIGN KEY (assignedTo) REFERENCES dbo.employees (employeeId)
);

GO", "sp_upsert": "CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_leadCaptures]
    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{
  "result": [
    {{ "value": "", "msg": "", "error": "" }}
  ]
}'
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @action INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')
    );

    DECLARE @payload TABLE (
        leadCaptureId           INT NULL,
        -- companyId removed from payload as per ADR-001 (not to be read/accepted from client)
        fullName                NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        email                   NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        normalizedEmailPayload  NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        companyName             NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        phone                   NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        jobTitle                NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        message                 NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        leadSource              NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        interestArea            NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        status                  NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        assignedTo              INT NULL,
        privacyConsentAccepted  BIT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        leadCaptureId,
        fullName,
        email,
        normalizedEmailPayload,
        companyName,
        phone,
        jobTitle,
        message,
        leadSource,
        interestArea,
        status,
        assignedTo,
        privacyConsentAccepted
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.fullName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.email'),
        LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(JSON_VALUE(value, '$.email')))),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.phone'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.jobTitle'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.message'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadSource'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.interestArea'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.assignedTo')),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.privacyConsentAccepted'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures');

    IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
    BEGIN
        -- Validate privacyConsentAccepted is TRUE
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @payload WHERE privacyConsentAccepted = 0 OR privacyConsentAccepted IS NULL)
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Privacy consent must be accepted.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for duplicates within the payload (by normalized email)
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload
            GROUP BY normalizedEmailPayload
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate lead entries with the same email within the payload.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table (by normalized email)
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.normalizedEmail = p.normalizedEmailPayload
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'A lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.leadCaptures (
            -- companyId is not supplied by client for public endpoint
            fullName,
            email,
            companyName,
            phone,
            jobTitle,
            message,
            leadSource,
            interestArea,
            status,
            assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted,
            created_At
        )
        SELECT
            p.fullName,
            p.email,
            p.companyName,
            p.phone,
            p.jobTitle,
            p.message,
            ISNULL(p.leadSource, 'Website'), -- Default leadSource if not provided
            p.interestArea,
            ISNULL(p.status, 'new'), -- Default status to 'new' if not provided
            p.assignedTo,
            p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            GETDATE()
        FROM @payload p;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicates within the payload, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload p
            GROUP BY p.normalizedEmailPayload
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate lead entries with the same email within the payload.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.normalizedEmail = p.normalizedEmailPayload
            WHERE lc.leadCaptureId <> p.leadCaptureId
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'A lead with this email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        }

        UPDATE lc
        SET
            -- companyId is not updatable via this generic SP as per ADR-001 (attribution happens server-side)
            fullName                = p.fullName,
            email                   = p.email,
            companyName             = p.companyName,
            phone                   = p.phone,
            jobTitle                = p.jobTitle,
            message                 = p.message,
            leadSource              = p.leadSource,
            interestArea            = p.interestArea,
            status                  = p.status,
            assignedTo              = p.assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted  = p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            updated_at              = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
    BEGIN
        DELETE lc
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId;
    END

    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

Finish:
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');
END CATCH

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
BEGIN
    -- ADR-001 (TENANT_INDEPENDENT) overrides the general rule for companyId filtering.
    -- This SP will return all leads, ignoring companyId in the input as it's not a tenant-scoped module.
    SELECT
        [leadCaptureId],
        ISNULL([companyId], 0)                          AS companyId,
        ISNULL([fullName], '')                          AS fullName,
        ISNULL([email], '')                             AS email,
        ISNULL([companyName], '')                       AS companyName,
        ISNULL([phone], '')                             AS phone,
        ISNULL([jobTitle], '')                          AS jobTitle,
        ISNULL([message], '')                           AS message,
        ISNULL([leadSource], '')                        AS leadSource,
        ISNULL([interestArea], '')                      AS interestArea,
        ISNULL([status], '')                            AS status,
        ISNULL([assignedTo], 0)                         AS assignedTo,
        ISNULL([privacyConsentAccepted], 0)             AS privacyConsentAccepted,
        [created_At],
        ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), updated_at, 126), '') AS updated_at
    FROM dbo.leadCaptures
    -- No filter due to ADR-001 (TENANT_INDEPENDENT).
    FOR JSON AUTO, ROOT('leadCaptures');
END
GO", "sp_one": "CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_leadCaptures_one] (@pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX))
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @leadCaptureId INT;
    SET @leadCaptureId = CAST(
        (SELECT TOP 1 JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')
         FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')) AS INT
    );
    SELECT
        leadCaptureId,
        ISNULL(companyId, 0)                            AS companyId,
        ISNULL(fullName, '')                            AS fullName,
        ISNULL(email, '')                               AS email,
        ISNULL(companyName, '')                         AS companyName,
        ISNULL(phone, '')                               AS phone,
        ISNULL(jobTitle, '')                            AS jobTitle,
        ISNULL(message, '')                             AS message,
        ISNULL(leadSource, '')                          AS leadSource,
        ISNULL(interestArea, '')                        AS interestArea,
        ISNULL(status, '')                              AS status,
        ISNULL(assignedTo, 0)                           AS assignedTo,
        ISNULL(privacyConsentAccepted, 0)               AS privacyConsentAccepted,
        created_At,
        ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), updated_at, 126), '') AS updated_at
    FROM dbo.leadCaptures
    WHERE leadCaptureId = @leadCaptureId
